# Scores

This area groups the clinical scoring systems and assessment tools used to evaluate patient risk, comorbidity, and physiological status within the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB). It covers models like the ASA classification and Charlson Score that are actively used to track quality indicators and identify high-risk patients, as well as comprehensive systems like APACHE and P-POSSUM that were evaluated but ultimately rejected for being too cumbersome for routine national reporting.

## Pages

- [[entities/scores/clinical-assessment/index|Clinical Assessment]] — Clinical scoring systems and assessment tools, such as ASA, Charlson, APACHE, and P-POSSUM, used to evaluate patient risk and track quality indicators in Danish acute surgery.
